name: Paul Fox
bio: Paul began his estate agency career as a trainee Chartered Surveyor and estate agent in 1978. Having passed his RICS examinations in 1983, Paul became an Assistant Valuer and Surveyor in Scunthorpe. Paul then opened his own Estate Agency in Scunthorpe in 1991. The Brigg office later opened in 1997, along with Commercial and Barton in 1999, Epworth in 2017 and finally Gainsborough in 2021. Paul Fox Lettings launched in 2001, covering a vast amount of the North Lincolnshire and Lincolnshire area. Paul has been a member of the National Association of Estate Agents since 1985.

name: Ryan Fox
role: Senior Regional Valuer and Associate Director
bio: Ryan has worked in the family business since leaving full time education. He has trained alongside his Dad to become one of the most experienced and knowledgeable Valuers in the area. Ryan is now a Senior Regional Valuer and prides himself on his friendly and confident approach when dealing with one of his clients most valuable assets. Ryan values each property individually and always offers an honest and professional opinion. Ryan works closely within the Finest Department and offers a high level of support to his historical as well as prospective clients.

name: Liam Fox
role: Chartered Valuation Surveyor and Associate Director
bio: Liam studied Real Estate Management at Nottingham Trent University and graduated in 2010 with BscHons. Liam then started his training to become a Chartered Surveyor. In 2015 Liam became AssocRICS and Registered Valuer and progressed to MRICS in 2017. Liam prides himself on managing our Survey Department and loves travelling across Lincolnshire and South Yorkshire, carrying out surveys and reports on a wide range of properties.

name: Hannah
bio: Hannah started her career as a legal secretary in 2010. She joined the Paul Fox Team as a Survey Secretary working alongside Paul and Liam in building the extremely successful Survey Team based in our Scunthorpe Office. Over the years Hannah’s role has now changed and is involved in the day to day running of the business.

name: Richard
bio: Richard is one of our Regional Valuers and loves working in Estate Agency and has thrived in this role. He has a wealth of knowledge within the local area and has quickly become an established Valuer. Richard enjoys visiting prospective clients and working closely with them to ensure a smooth start to the marketing of their property.

name: Ben
bio: Ben began his estate agency career in 2018 and has never looked back. Having now achieved numerous years in varying roles within the property sector, Ben is excited to be a regional valuer for our Scunthorpe and Gainsborough branches. Ben loves interacting with clients on appointments and has the customer service skills to match.

name: Malcolm
bio: After a 35 year career in the world of Advertising, with the largest regional newsbrand in the UK, Malcolm joined Paul Fox Estate Agents in May 2025 to lead our Marketing and Business Development.

name: Scott
bio: Scott joined the Paul Fox Team as a Regional Energy Performance Assessor and during this role has carried out 1000’s of these Surveys. Scott takes pride in all his Reports and enjoys meeting new clients on a daily basis. Scott has also progressed to be our Regional Lettings Valuer, where he has excelled in customer service and uses his local knowledge to ensure correct market values are achieved, excellent tenants are found and tenancies maintained to a superior standard.

name: Michelle
bio: Michelle is one of our longest serving employees and began her career at Paul Fox as a Receptionist in our Scunthorpe branch over 20 years ago. Throughout this time Michelle has progressed to a Senior Sales Negotiator within the Branch and her extensive years of experience in making any sale run as efficiently and smoothly as possible make her an invaluable member of the Team.

name: Jackie
bio: Jackie began her career with Paul Fox shortly after the Epworth Branch opened in 2017. She previously had a long career in banking, including mortgages, personal and business banking. Jackie’s main focus is always providing excellent customer service and using her knowledge of property sales and lettings to offer her clients outstanding advice and support. With Jackie’s infectious personality she quickly became a favourite with her clients.

name: Meg
bio: Megan enjoys working as the Branch Manager in our Gainsborough office. Since leaving school, Megan has worked in several customer facing roles and this has helped her build an exceptional level of customer service skills and professionalism. From the initial conversation with vendors and potential buyers to handing over the keys, Megan prides herself on ensuring that the sale runs as smooth as possible.

name: Becci
bio: Becci’s career in estate agency started with Paul Fox as an office junior. Becci now manages our Finest Department offering a one-to-one bespoke service along with carrying out viewings, valuations and negotiating. Becci’s passion is property, she has gained a wealth of knowledge from having over 20 years in estate agency and is able to pass this onto all our clients.

name: Taylor
bio: A Sales Negotiator and the face behind our social media, Taylor has been with us for 2 years and has become a key part of the Scunthorpe team. Alongside her role in sales, she shares everything from new listings to team moments, giving you an insight into all things Paul Fox.

name: Karen
bio: Karen has worked for Paul Fox for several years and has experience in many roles throughout sales and lettings. Karen has settled as our Scunthorpe branches Sales Receptionist, where she focuses on providing great customer service.

name: Teresa
bio: Teresa started with Paul Fox when our Scunthorpe office first opened in the early 90’s. Teresa then decided to change careers and trained as a hospital phlebotomist, but soon realised her heart would always be in Estate Agency. Teresa has been back at Paul Fox since 2015 and loves being in our busy Epworth office where her experience is often called upon to ensure a smooth sale for her clients.

name: Jo
bio: Jo has worked in estate agency for over 20 years and has a wealth of experience. Jo currently works as a Sales Negotiator in our Brigg branch and has experience in valuing properties. From a house coming onto the market, right through to completion and handing over the keys, Jo enjoys every aspect of the role.

name: Neve
bio: Neve came to Paul Fox from college and enjoys meeting and speaking with clients. Neve is currently working towards gaining a qualification in Estate Agency and loves working in our busy Brigg Branch. Neve takes pride in booking viewings, taking valuations and answering general enquiries.

name: Zoe
bio: Zoe started her journey at Paul Fox in our Scunthorpe branch as a receptionist. After a few years of experience within the property sector, Zoe was then promoted to a full-time sales negotiator within our Barton office. Zoe is devoted to offering local knowledge and expertise to help both vendors and purchasers on their property adventure.

name: Sarah
bio: Sarah started at Paul Fox as an office junior but now thrives in our Barton office as a Sales Negotiator. Sarah prides herself in offering an exceptional level of customer service to our clients, old and new. Sarah also has great local knowledge thanks to her years of experience at Paul Fox.

name: Millie
bio: Since leaving school, Millie has worked in customer facing roles, this has boosted her skills and professionalism. Millie started her career with Paul Fox in the Scunthorpe Branch as a Sales Receptionist but we saw her potential and has since moved to our Gainsborough Branch as a Trainee Sales Negotiator. Millie prides herself in offering an exceptional level of service.

name: Sharna
bio: The newest member of the team, Sharna joined Paul Fox Estate Agents just a few months ago and is currently training in the world of estate agency. Eager to learn and always ready to lend a hand, she’s already made a fantastic start to her journey.

name: Laura
bio: Laura joined us in 2024 and quickly became a valued part of the team. Friendly, organised, and always willing to go the extra mile, she’s grown in confidence every day and brings great energy to the Lettings office. Laura became our Lettings Manager in June 2026.

name: Amanda
bio: Amanda joined the rapidly expanding Paul Fox Lettings team after a 30-year career in Marketing and Advertising. Amanda prides herself in offering excellent customer service and loves the busy atmosphere. Along with the rest of the Team, Amanda is constantly keeping herself updated on all Lettings Regulations.

name: Kia
bio: The newest member of the Paul Fox ‘family’. Kia has joined us after four years working in the NHS. We’re delighted to have Kia on board and are sure that she will be a fantastic addition to the team and our clients.

name: Heather
bio: Heather moved from Northamptonshire to North Lincolnshire and started working in the educational sector but then began her career with Paul Fox. As our Lettings Receptionist, Heather is knowledgeable and loves working with a variety of customers.

name: Sorelle
bio: Sorelle finished school and went onto college and University. She ended up helping her Dad and Uncle out at Clive Smith Butchers, where she worked there for 6 years and worked her way up from a Saturday girl to an Senior Counter Staff/Office Manager. Sorelle had a career change and came to Paul Fox as a lettings negotiator and loves working in the busy environment.

name: Katrina
bio: Katrina has worked in administration for over 25 years and has been employed by local solicitors, doctors, and finance companies. Katrina now works full time as the Administration Manager in our Survey and Admin Department where she is always on hand to offer professional survey advice on all types of Survey required.

name: Amelia
bio: Since leaving education, Amelia has worked in administration roles starting her career at a local firm of solicitors. Amelia works in our admin team where she types sales brochures for all our five branches and liaises with our valuers and clients. She also undertakes work within the Survey Department and enjoys working closely with the Surveyors and other members of her Team.
